correctness.rationale: The proof extends the source quadratic dissipation identity to the coexistence mass regime, derives a two-branch global limit classification from conservation and Poincare decay, proves convergence of b by a mean-zero energy estimate, and excludes boundary convergence for every positive initial catalyst mass using the strictly positive boundary invasion gap.

originality.rationale: The 2026 source explicitly leaves possible return to the boundary unresolved and states a global-attraction conjecture. Searches found no later correction or source-specific proof of the exact basin decomposition. Standard parabolic and Lyapunov tools are not claimed as new.

value.rationale: The result gives the exact basin boundary in the unresolved coexistence regime, proves the intended global-attraction statement under the sharp condition of positive catalyst mass, and identifies the invariant catalyst-free face as a necessary exception to the conjecture as literally worded.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, or a guarantee of first discovery.
